Workshop: Bilingual Sentence Alignment & Leipzig Interlinear Glossing

Overview: In this workshop, you will align a 10-sentence passage from your manuscript witness with a modern translation. You will author four-line Interlinear Glossed Text (IGT) for three complex sentences according to the Leipzig Glossing Rules and encode the alignment as stand-off TEI <linkGrp> XML.

Deadlines: Comparison Post due Friday by 11:00 PM; Peer Reviews due Monday by 11:00 PM.
